title: Do They Sing to Their Babies?

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Hearing a lullaby from a nearby hut, a teenager wonders whether parents everywhere sing their babies to sleep.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Hearing a lullaby from a nearby hut, (name1), a teenager, wonders whether parents everywhere sing their babies to sleep.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: An elder suggests that tired parents everywhere might hum to quiet a crying child.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A parent says that some parents do not sing at all and still love their children just as much.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A musician imagines distant lullabies in strange rhythms and tries to hum one.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A scholar says there is no way to know any distant song, so they record their own lullabies instead.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Villagers sing the oldest lullaby they know, and several babies fall asleep.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The singing wakes a baby who was finally asleep, and everyone tiptoes away guiltily.
